name: Riichi
description: Declaring riichi while tenpai with a closed hand. Player places 1000 points on the table and draws only, discarding until winning.

name: Ippatsu
description: Winning within one full round of turns after declaring riichi, before any calls are made.

name: Menzen Tsumo
description: Winning by self-draw with a closed hand.

name: Tanyao
description: Hand composed entirely of tiles numbered 2–8 (simples), with no terminals or honors.

name: Pinfu
description: Closed hand with four sequences (no triplets), a non-yakuhai pair, and a two-sided wait (ryanmen).

name: Iipeiko
description: Two identical sequences in a closed hand.

name: Yakuhai (Yakupai)
description: A triplet or quad of dragon tiles, the round wind, or the seat wind.

name: Haitei Raoyue
description: Winning by self-draw on the very last drawable tile.

name: Houtei Raoyui
description: Winning by ron on the very last discarded tile.

name: Rinshan Kaihou
description: Winning by self-draw on the dead-wall draw after declaring a kan.

name: Chankan
description: Winning by ron when an opponent adds a tile to an existing pon to form a closed kan.

name: Tsumo (Menzen Tsumo)
description: Winning by self-draw with a fully closed hand. Same as Menzen Tsumo; listed separately for clarity.

name: San Ankou
description: Three concealed triplets (not formed by ron) in the hand.

name: San Kantsu
description: Three kans (quads) of any kind in the hand.

name: Toitoi
description: Hand composed entirely of triplets (and a pair); no sequences.

name: San Shoku Doujun
description: The same sequence appearing in all three suits (man, pin, sou).

name: San Shoku Doukou
description: The same triplet (same number) appearing in all three suits.

name: Ittsu (Straight)
description: Three sequences in the same suit spanning 1–3, 4–6, and 7–9.

name: Chanta
description: Every set and the pair contain at least one terminal or honor tile.

name: Chiitoi
description: A hand of seven different pairs. Always worth 25 fu.

name: Honitsu
description: Hand using tiles from only one suit plus honor tiles.

name: Junchan
description: Every set and the pair contain a terminal (1 or 9) tile; no honor tiles.

name: Ryanpeiko
description: Two sets of two identical sequences (double iipeiko) in a closed hand.

name: Chinitsu
description: Hand using tiles from only one suit with no honor tiles.

name: Kokushi Musou
description: Yakuman. One of each of the thirteen terminals and honors (1m 9m 1p 9p 1s 9s 1z–7z) plus any duplicate of one of them.

name: Suuankou
description: Yakuman. Four concealed triplets, all formed without ron (tsumo win or tanki ron).

name: Daisangen
description: Yakuman. Three triplets of all three dragon tiles (haku, hatsu, chun).

name: Shousuushi
description: Yakuman. Three triplets of wind tiles and a pair of the fourth wind.

name: Daisuushi
description: Yakuman (double yakuman in some rulesets). Four triplets of all four wind tiles.

name: Tsuuiisou
description: Yakuman. Hand composed entirely of honor tiles.

name: Ryuuiisou
description: Yakuman. Hand composed entirely of green tiles: 2s 3s 4s 6s 8s and/or hatsu (6z).

name: Chinroutou
description: Yakuman. Hand composed entirely of terminal tiles (1s and 9s of each suit).

name: Suukantsu
description: Yakuman. Four kans (quads) of any kind.

name: Chuurenpoutou
description: Yakuman. Closed hand in one suit with the pattern 1112345678999 plus any tile of that suit.

name: Tenhou
description: Yakuman. Dealer wins on their initial dealt hand (before any draws or discards).

name: Chiihou
description: Yakuman. Non-dealer wins by tsumo on their very first draw, before any calls have been made.

name: Double Riichi
description: Declaring riichi on the very first discard of the hand, before any calls have been made.
